proposal.domain: Single-store retail point-of-sale and inventory tracking
proposal.summary: Proposed foundation for a fictional one-store POS supporting barcode lookup, cash sales, and inventory tracking. The BA retains authority over scope, policies, and approval. All supplied text is treated as project data, not confirmed obligations or stakeholder decisions. Policies are concise safeguards emphasizing human oversight, traceability, source provenance, and review before reliance on outputs.
policies: BA retains authority over scope, policies and approval
All requirements and decisions require documented BA review before implementation
Source provenance must be recorded for all project data and assumptions
POS scope is limited to one store, barcode lookup, cash sales, and inventory tracking unless BA approves expansion
No confirmed legal, tax, or payment-card obligations are assumed; regulatory applicability requires review
Inventory counts and sales records require human verification before financial reliance
Changes to policies require BA approval and recorded rationale
